editorial:
Imagine moving into a house only to find out the Wi-Fi is possessed by a grumpy spirit. That is exactly what happens at Morningwood Road in this wild animated ride. You follow a group of friends who just want to scroll through their feeds, but they end up in a digital battle for their social lives. The vibe is totally chaotic and feels like a giant inside joke about how much we all rely on the internet. It is a lighthearted story that pokes fun at internet culture and the fear of becoming a laughing stock online.

What really works here is the fast pacing and the colorful animation style that keeps your eyes glued to the screen. While some of the jokes might feel a bit random, the energy never drops. If you are looking for something silly to watch on a Friday night, you should definitely check this out. It is the perfect pick for anyone who spends too much time on social media.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up when the friends finally figure out what the ghost actually wants. Instead of fighting her, they help her find peace by creating a viral post that honors her memory. Once she feels seen and appreciated by the internet, she stops the chaos and leaves them alone. The twist is that she just wanted to be famous, and by making her a legend, they save themselves from becoming memes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves social media jokes and goofy cartoons.
